summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Q3 All-Season Tactical Advantage ETF (QTAC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. The fund aims for capital appreciation by investing in a combination of futures contracts on US equity indexes, leveraged US equity and fixed income index ETFs, as well as short-term bonds. QTAC was launched on Dec 16, 2025 and is issued by Q3.
